tutorials.title: Cut a clean first edit
tutorials.summary: Learn timeline basics, trimming, and how to create a smooth story flow with your footage.
tutorials.content: Start by organizing your clips into groups. Trim the dead space, build a rough structure, and keep the story simple before you add effects. Good edits often start with clean timing and clean pacing.

tutorials.title: Match cuts & transitions
tutorials.summary: Use beat-sync, match cut transitions, and motion blur to make edits feel cinematic.
tutorials.content: Transitions should support the story rather than distract from it. Try matching action, movement, or color between clips and use a very light transition when the timing feels right.

tutorials.title: Speed ramps & motion effects
tutorials.summary: Build energy with speed ramps, keyframes, and directional motion that keeps viewers engaged.
tutorials.content: Speed ramps are one of the quickest ways to add drama to a scene. Start small, maintain consistency, and use the motion to enhance the storytelling instead of overwhelming it.

resources.title: Recommended workflow
resources.description: Start with rough assembly, then refine with motion, color, captions, and sound.

resources.title: Best export settings
resources.description: Use consistent frame rate and a clean bitrate for crisp uploads on social platforms.

resources.title: Captions and readability
resources.description: Use large text, high contrast, and short phrases to keep viewers focused.
